title: The Belmont Belle
description:
Book your next stay in this curated guesthouse that is a perfect blend of city + cozy.  The ideal location puts you within easy walking distance of all that the 12S neighborhood has to offer, along with a quaint grocery store, and a beautiful park.  A short distance from Vanderbilt, Belmont & Lipscomb colleges, and less than 4 miles from downtown Nashville.  The full kitchen is also well equipped for a comfortable night in.

The space
Enjoy our amazing city and everything that the incredibly vibrant & charming neighborhood of 12 South has to offer!  Our brand new guest house was built in 2024. 

For stays longer than 30 nights, please contact us for rates.  We happily welcome traveling professionals that are looking for a safe, comfortable & furnished place to land. 

Google fiber fast speed internet. 

The space features all local art by artist; Ashleigh Suarez and available for purchase right off the walls with shipping available. Inquire for pricing.

The full kitchen is equipped with:
*Sub-Zero 36" undercounter Refrigerator/freezer drawers with ice maker
*Wolf 30" Induction Cooktop with built-in ventilation above
*Wolf 30" Electric wall oven
*Wolf 24" microwave drawer
*Asko 24" fully integrated dishwasher
*Built-in double trash pull-out cabinet
*Fully stocked with induction ready pots/pans
*All cooking utensils needed
*Cutlery, plates, bowls, mugs, glasses, wine glasses 

You'll also enjoy the use of the Wolf gourmet coffee maker, blender, and toaster as needed. The kitchen sink has a disposal. 

The living room has built-in storage to house board games + sheets/blankets for the sofa bed option.  The couch has the option to pull out only 1 side for a twin bed, or both sides for a king.  55" Roku TV with the YouTubeTV loaded.  There isn't a bad seat in the house, as the TV is on an articulating arm to move around as you need.

You'll enjoy a cozy stay in the bedroom nestled into the King bed with CasaLuna brand bedding. 43" Roku TV with YouTubeTV app loaded.  The south facing windows have pull down shades + black out curtains. Extra deep full closet with hanging rod & hangers provided.  Closet includes; 
*Luggage rack
*Pack & play crib with bedding
*electric fan
*noise machine
*Iron + Ironing board
*Air purifier 

The spa-like bathroom boasts Brizo branded fixtures with a Kohler Bidet seat toilet.  Shampoo/conditioner/body wash & hair dryer are provided.

Guest access
Guest drive access is via the pea-gravel drive on the left side of the main house.  You'll have easy off-street parking for 1 car to the left of the garage door.  If you need parking for a 2nd car, please let us know and we're happy to accommodate in our other driveway so that the garage door access is not blocked. 

**City trash & recycle bins are located behind the guest house with access via a concrete walkway to the left of the garage door.

**Should you need access to a washer & dryer, we are happy to provide key access to the pair for your use in the garage.

Other things to note
